units.source_text: 一天，男人正面看到了月亮，挂在洞穴的边缘，有一抱那么大，灰白色，当时正在小便，突然，他感到一阵剧烈的发冷。

en.t: One day, the man saw the moon straight ahead of him, hanging on the edge of the hole, as large as an armful and grayish white; while he was urinating, he suddenly felt a violent chill.
... No, this chill seemed to be different in kind.

units.source_text: 假如是发热之前的冷，自己还有几分经验，可眼前的情景简直不一样。

en.t: If it were the chill before a fever, he had some experience of that, but what was happening now was completely different.

units.source_text: 空气里没有激刺感，也没有起鸡皮疙瘩。

en.t: There was no stinging sensation in the air, and no gooseflesh rose on his skin.

units.source_text: 与其说皮肤表面打抖，还不知说是在骨髓周围打抖。

en.t: Rather than his skin trembling on the surface, it was more as if the trembling were happening around his marrow.

units.source_text: 那颤抖像水的波纹，慢慢地形成一个个圈圈，由中心向外扩散。

en.t: The trembling was like ripples on water, slowly forming ring after ring and spreading outward from the center.

units.source_text: 钝感的疼痛在骨头间传递共鸣，似乎没有停止的迹象。

en.t: A dull pain traveled and resonated between his bones, showing no sign of stopping.

units.source_text: 简直就像一个锈迹斑斑的马口铁罐子，随风飞来，哐啷哐啷响着穿过身体而去。

en.t: It was just like a rusty tin can blown in by the wind, clattering noisily as it passed straight through his body.
